bestBets.overview: BOOMING BELIEF started favourite at Cairns last start but was beaten less than a length and had to settle for minor placing. Drawn touch wide but the 1200m will suit. AUCHTERARDER fought the race out strongly when less than a length off winner here last start. Only needs to produce similar to be right in the mix. FOXY CHEVAL held her ground when just out of placings at Cairns last start. She is a must for exotics while WATEGOS BAY made some good late ground last start and the extra distance will be ideal.

raceTips.comment: We race at Townsville on Tuesday under fine skies on a perfect deck. The meeting gets underway with a 1200m maiden which is low on depth & for that reason I'm siding with the debutante Far And Wide who had 4 trials with Team Cavanough down south, the latest of those a Muswellbrook 2nd back in July. Fitness levels obviously the query however should there be any money about I'd follow it in. Booming Belief & Auchterarder have claims on recent efforts however neither have been strong late which is concerning.

bestBets.overview: OVERLAND looks ready to get his maiden out of the way. He has been close-up when placed in his last two starts and this a nice race for him. ALL BANGED UP just did not finish the race off when tired after leading at Cairns last start. He had been placed in two runs prior and from ideal barrier must consider. ROSSA VISTA made good late ground when an eye-catcher at Cairns last start. If he can sit a bit closer he may give this a shake while ITS SHOWTIME was beaten less than 2 lengths at Cairns last start and watch for him late.

raceTips.comment: He's a long time maiden Overland however gets another chance here & to be honest does have the best form lines to win the race. By the same token I wouldn't be jumping into a short quote. The lightly raced Rossa Vista looms as the logical threat, looks to be building to a win & although failed this trip two back there were valid excuses.

bestBets.overview: LOWLANDS finished too well and got the prize at Cairns last start. Should sit in behind the speed and will have last crack at leaders late. IMPARDOO looked like he would benefit from his first-up effort at Cairns. Raced well enough last time in work and will strip much fitter for this. HARTSHORN has not been finishing his races off well enough of late but he has early speed and expect him to be up front for a long way while LAST DITCH EFFORT finished too well to win at Mount Isa last start and from ideal barrier no reason he cannot make it two in a row.

raceTips.comment: Not much depth to this open dash over the 1000m trip. Viburnum failed at Cairns however that was in a much tougher race & as his priced suggested he wasn't expected to show up, a wide trip certainly didn't help though. Prior form good enough to get away with this or at least get close. Lowlands rises in grade however is in winning form, slight weight relief.

bestBets.overview: BRIGINSHAW started favourite at Cairns last start but he just could not run first couple down final 100m. Drawn touch wide but if he can get some cover in behind the speed he will go close. MIND OVER MATTER has been making some good late ground of late. Perfect barrier and if he gets some luck from the corner he will be hitting line hard. TOUCH BASE has been finding city class a bit too hot of late. Back in right race and he should be an improver while MONDAY CLOSE led all the way for dominant maiden win last start. This is harder but he may try similar tactics.

raceTips.comment: I'll take a punt on Briginshaw here who just might be a better horse ridden cold than on pace. He box seated here over 1200m here two back yet couldn't finish off, at Cairns he settled off speed & closed well. From the wide gate here there's a good chance he will go back. Touch Base the newcomer to the area is the big market watch.

bestBets.overview: MINNIE VEGAS showed good speed and led them up for a long way at Cairns last start. Drawn to lead again and if she can get a breather before the corner she can get away with this. KICKOFF was brave in defeat at first start since coming to Queensland. Sure to strip fitter and another that will sit in first couple and take running down. TAMBOS SISTER was not beaten all that far when beaten favourite first-up. Fitter and must include. BREECHES battled on well enough at Mackay last start. May find this a touch easier and can sneak a place.

raceTips.comment: Tambo's Sister is only lightly raced & strips fitter for the first up run when close up in the placings here. Very consistent to date he'll strip fitter for it & with a touch of luck off the wide draw prove hard to beat. Dance For Me Randy is having start number three for the prep & should be ready to fire, drawn to do just that.

bestBets.overview: SUPERVISE resumes from spell in new stable. Model of consistency in Victoria last time in work and finished campaign with a win oin the synthetic. If he can find that form fresh he can win. EXTRA FREE only missed by barest possible margin here last start. Should sit in first couple and will be in finish again. SHES SPEEDY won here two starts back then was bit flat last start when beaten favourite. She can bounce back in this while LATIN BOSS finished too well winning at Cairns last start and althoug drawn wide he is a must for first four players.

raceTips.comment: Big watch here is the ex-Victorian galloper Supervise who showed good potential down south however comes up hare having not raced for 413 days, clearly there have been issues. No official trials either, it's all about the market... Extra Free looks to be getting very close to another win & gets down in the weights here.

bestBets.overview: TORANAGA went forward and was only claimed late at Cairns last start. Barrier is a concern but Paul Hammersley takes the mount and if he can find an early position he will take catching. THE IMPECKABLE chased home strongly and got the job done at Cairns last start. Drawn perfectly and he should get all the favours in the run. INTREPID LAD started favourite at Mackay last start and he got the job down. No reason he cannot feature again while MUSKITO led all the way at Cairns last start. Expect they will try similar tactics in this.

raceTips.comment: Talons is consistent without winning, he certainly doesn't do so out of turn. The positive is the gate & he ticks the track & trip boxes, just get the feeling he'll gain a good run here & therefore rates a solid each-way chance. Garinion Righ won well fresh, he's more than capable of making it 2 from 2 this prep, don't overlook.
